title: ModelExperimentConfig
description: Declarative experiment config only. Does not authorize training or publication. Presence-only must not be treated as absence. Protocols must not be mixed. A baseline is required. Final holdout year must not be used for tuning. Every accepted run must emit a manifest.

protocol_id.description: Single observation protocol. Mixing protocols in one experiment is forbidden.

additional_protocol_ids.description: Must be empty. A second protocol in the same experiment is a reject.

mix_protocols.description: Must remain false. Visual census, trawl, and ichthyoplankton are not pooled.

require_run_manifest.description: Every run must write checksums, seed, train years, holdout year, code version, NOT_PUBLISHED.

label_semantics.description: PRESENCE_ONLY_NO_ABSENCE forbids treating gaps as absence zeros.

treat_presence_only_as_absence.description: Must remain false when label_semantics is PRESENCE_ONLY_NO_ABSENCE.

holdout_year.description: Locked final evaluation year; scored once; never used for tuning or refit.
